<b>Craw Jurors</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are [[Craws|Craw]] scavengers with pelts dyed black, to mourn [[Pharloom]]'s collapse.<ref>Craw Juror [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Screeching scavenger dyed black in mourning at their land's collapse."</i></ref> They are the [[Act 3]] counterparts to [[Craw]]s, with more health, a slightly higher damage modifier, and an immunity to head-on attacks while swooping.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Craw Jurors are often found sitting on various things, including things in the background or foreground. When they spot Hornet, they take flight and pursue her.<br>
They fly in short arcing flaps, and try to maintain distance between themselves and Hornet, performing a horizontal swooping attack at her once they've aligned themselves with her.
Craw Jurors' metal beak plating gives their attacks a special property where attempting to attack them head-on as they swoop results in a Parry, as opposed to their attack being interrupted. This means that chasing them as they fly and reposition is much more beneficial for damage, since their forward swoops are likely to negate counterattacks.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
*Guilty! Guilty!
*Lay down your judgement!
*Father, Father!
*Punish the villain!
}}

== Location ==
Before defeating [[Crawfather]], Craw Jurors replace existing Craws in [[Craw Lake]] and adjacent rooms in [[Greymoor]] in [[Act 3]]. They also spawn during the [[Court of Craws]] fight. After Crawfather's defeat, Craw Jurors no longer appear.
